title: Physics-Constrained Neural ODEs for Learning Traffic Dynamics and Trajectories from Road Entry/Exit Times
abstract: arXiv:2611.30577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider the problem of learning microscopic traffic dynamics and reconstructing vehicle trajectories from section entry/exit timestamps (EET) recorded by cameras and from the positions of a probe vehicle leading the platoon. The dynamics are difficult to recover as each vehicle's position is measured only at two points, and its trajectory between them is unknown. By combining Neural ODEs with a local density approximation, we learn a follow-the-leader model whose speed--density relation is a neural network. With such sparse data, an unconstrained network may learn physically unrealistic relations, such as negative speeds or non-zero speeds on a fully congested road. We therefore introduce a normalization that, applied to a monotone neural network with a learned regime change, enforces the endpoint conditions, guaranteeing an admissible speed--density relation while provably retaining the ability to approximate any admissible one. translated_title: 物理约束的神经常微分方程：从道路进出时间学习交通动力学与车辆轨迹
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何从摄像头记录的路段进出时间戳（EET）以及领航排头探测车的位置来学习微观交通动力学并重建车辆轨迹。由于每辆车的位置仅在两个点被测量，其间的轨迹未知，因此动力学难以恢复。通过将神经常微分方程与局部密度近似相结合，我们学习了一个跟驰模型，其速度-密度关系由神经网络表示。在如此稀疏的数据下，无约束的网络可能学到物理上不现实的关系，例如负速度或完全拥堵道路上非零的速度。为此，我们引入了一种归一化方法，将其应用于带有可学习状态切换的单调神经网络，以强制满足端点条件，从而保证速度-密度关系的可容许性，同时可证明地保留了对任意可容许速度-密度关系的逼近能力。
tldr: 该论文提出一种物理约束的神经常微分方程方法，仅凭稀疏的路段进出时间与领航车位置数据，即可学习物理上合理的交通跟驰动力学并重建车辆轨迹。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes physics-constrained Neural ODEs that learn physically admissible car-following traffic dynamics and reconstruct vehicle trajectories from sparse road entry/exit timestamps and probe vehicle data.
